summary: Evommune, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 8, 2026 (Items 7.01, 8.01, 9.01) disclosing top-line results from its Phase 2b trial of oral MRGPRX2 antagonist EVO756 in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis. The randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, dose-ranging study enrolled 121 adults over a 12-week treatment period with follow-up through Week 14, but failed to meet primary and secondary endpoints at any dose studied. Evommune will cease development of EVO756 for AD but continue evaluating it in migraine prophylaxis, expecting current cash, cash equivalents, and investments to fund operations into 2029. This is a clinical-results event, not a special situation.
